facts.fact: Connected TVs capture approximately 58% of all time spent with digital video, according to eMarketer research from 2025 as cited by AdWave.
facts.quote: Connected TVs now capture approximately 58% of all time spent with digital video, while mobile devices account for 48.6% of total digital media time

facts.fact: Mobile devices account for 48.6% of total digital media time, according to eMarketer research from 2025 as cited by AdWave.
facts.quote: mobile devices account for 48.6% of total digital media time, according to [eMarketer](https://thedesk.net/2025/07/emarketer-time-spent-digital-media-2025-survey-doordash/) research from 2025

facts.fact: Connected TV platforms account for approximately 30% of time spent with digital media daily, according to eMarketer research as cited by AdWave.
facts.quote: connected TV platforms now account for approximately 58% of time spent with digital video and 30% of time spent with digital media daily

facts.fact: Approximately 85% of U.S. households have at least one smart TV, according to Leichtman Research as cited by AdWave.
facts.quote: approximately 85% of U.S. households now having at least one smart TV according to [Leichtman Research]

facts.fact: Adwave states that advertisers can reach CTV audiences through its programmatic platform with budgets starting as low as $30 a day.
facts.quote: allowing advertisers to reach CTV audiences with budgets starting as low as $30 a day.

facts.fact: The page's FAQ states that local businesses can reach streaming audiences through programmatic platforms with budgets starting as low as $50, which differs from the $30-a-day minimum stated elsewhere on the same page.
facts.quote: Local businesses can reach streaming audiences with budgets starting as low as $50 through programmatic platforms.

facts.fact: The page states that 58% of video viewing occurs on connected TVs.
facts.quote: With 58% of video viewing occurring on connected TVs, CTV should represent the majority of video advertising spend for most businesses.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer (2025), CTV accounts for approximately 58% of time spent with digital video.
Mobile accounts for 48.6% of total digital media time, a figure that includes social media and messaging rather than only video.
facts.quote: Mobile accounts for more total digital media time (48.6%) but this includes social media, messaging, and other non-video content.

facts.fact: The page reports that approximately 85% of U.S. households have at least one smart TV, according to Leichtman Research.
facts.quote: Approximately 85% of U.S. households now have at least one smart TV, according to Leichtman Research.

facts.fact: The page cites Leichtman Research for a smart TV household penetration of approximately 85%.
The page states that CTV accounts for 30% of daily digital media time, without citing a source.
facts.quote: CTV share of daily digital media time: 30%

facts.fact: The page identifies 7 PM to 11 PM as the peak TV streaming hours.
facts.quote: Peak TV streaming hours: 7 PM - 11 PM

facts.fact: The page states that evening hours from 7 PM to 11 PM offer the highest CTV viewership and attention levels.
facts.quote: Evening hours (7 PM - 11 PM) offer the highest CTV viewership and attention levels.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its ads can run across more than 100 streaming platforms.
facts.quote: Your ads can run across 100+ streaming platforms, reaching engaged viewers in your target area during primetime viewing sessions.

facts.fact: The page states that its data is current as of August 2025.
